description: Agent Delegation: submit one delegation as supplied: who delegates to whom, where its bounds are written (a delegation record both sides read, a message to the delegate, only code or configuration, or nowhere), when they were written and when work started, the tasks the delegate may do and whether the list ends in open wording, whether it may spend with the ceiling and what it counts over (the whole delegation, each task, each payment, a day, a week or a month), the tools and data it may use, and what ends it (the task being done, a date, a length of time, only a revocation, or nothing). The signed report says bound by bound whether the scope is stated before work starts, which tasks, what spend, which tools and data and for how long, and names bounds written nowhere, bounds written after work started, no named tasks, open task wording, spending with no ceiling and no end, then bounds set only in code, unstated spending, a ceiling with no period, unnamed or open tools and data, an end only on revocation and an end with no date or length, with the fix for each. This audits the written bounds of one delegation from the delegator’s side: whether a delegation or mandate document marks its grantee, caps, expiry, revocation and approvals present is wever_delegation-check, issuing a signed mandate is wever_delegated-authority and what each receiver gets against what its task needs in an agent-to-agent handoff is wever_handoff-scope-check. A one-record restatement is wever_delegation-snapshot on https://weverlabs.com/mcp-free. Verdict blank_check, scope_gaps, scope_unverified or scope_bounded. POST /api/delegation-scope-check. Reads only the material in the call: no network request, fetch, money movement, message, sharing, configuration change or external write. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-delegation-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-delegation/.
